|lore=Mercenary from Vodran. Niado's culture controls its environment through terraforming facilities. Enhanced adrenal glands allow for short bursts of incredible strength.
|anagram=Decipher's photo for this card shows "Alien 18", an alien model built for ''Return of the Jedi'' that looks like a [[Dianoga|dianoga]]. It was dropped from the film because it was too hard to operate.<ref name="swcom">Kevin Beentjes, [https://www.starwars.com/news/back-from-the-drawing-board-recycled-star-wars-aliens Back from the Drawing Board: Recycled Star Wars Aliens], StarWars.com (October 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20141007212642/http://www.starwars.com/news/back-from-the-drawing-board-recycled-star-wars-aliens Internet Archive], 7 October 2014.</ref> With no name from the film to use, Decipher called him a "Dianoga Dude" and scrambled the letters into ''Niado Duegad'', which uses exactly the same eleven letters. Dianogas are tentacled carnivores that live in stagnant water and garbage and drag their prey under, so usually only the eyestalk shows. The best-known one lives in the Death Star trash compactor in ''Star Wars'' (1977).<ref name="sw-dianoga">[https://www.starwars.com/databank/dianoga Dianoga], StarWars.com Databank. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261014053301/https://www.starwars.com/databank/dianoga Internet Archive], 14 October 2026.</ref> The card's lore gives Niado an unrelated backstory, as a mercenary from Vodran, and doesn't mention dianogas. The 1990s fan list "Anagramed Decipherians" spells the answer "Diaogana Dude". That spelling has one more A than the card has, so it is most likely a typo.<ref name="geo">[https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians] at oocities.org (GeoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008200413/https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Internet Archive], 8 October 2026.</ref>
|game_text=May not carry or use devices or weapons. Once per turn, may use X Force, where X = 1, 2, or 3, to add twice X to his power for remainder of turn.
